definitions.explanation: A collective term for the three types of basic local government units in Japan: cities (市), towns (町), and villages (村). Used in administrative, political, and geographical contexts.

examples.japanese: ⟦{全国|ぜんこく}→全国：03311_zenkoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{市町村|しちょうそん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{通知|つうち}→通知：04061_tsuuchi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}した→出す：01087_dasu⟧。
examples.english: A notification was sent to municipalities nationwide.

examples.japanese: {市町村|しちょうそん}⟦{合併|がっぺい}→合併：04778_gappei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧、⟦{自治体|じちたい}→自治体：13946_jichitai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{数|かず}→数：00204_kazu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{減|へ}っている→減る：01985_heru⟧。
examples.english: The number of local governments is decreasing due to municipal mergers.

examples.japanese: ⟦{各|かく}→各〜：00449_kaku⟧{市町村|しちょうそん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{独自|どくじ}→独自：05614_dokuji⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{子育|こそだ}て→子育て：12226_kosodate⟧⟦{支援|しえん}→支援：07778_shien⟧⟦{制度|せいど}→制度：03291_seido⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{設|もう}けている→設ける：14220_moukeru⟧。
examples.english: Each municipality has established its own childcare support system.

notes:
USAGE:
{市町村|しちょうそん} is a compound of ⟦{市|し}→市：01599_shi⟧ (city), {町|ちょう} (town), and {村|そん} (village). These are the basic units of local government in Japan, below the prefectural (⟦{都道府県|とどうふけん}→都道府県：14502_todoufuken⟧) level.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {市町村|しちょうそん}⟦{合併|がっぺい}→合併：04778_gappei⟧ (municipal merger)
- {市町村|しちょうそん}{長|ちょう} (mayor of a municipality)
- {市町村|しちょうそん}⟦{役場|やくば}→役場：16694_yakuba⟧ (municipal office)
- ⟦{各|かく}→各〜：00449_kaku⟧{市町村|しちょうそん} (each municipality)

SIMILAR WORDS:
⟦{自治体|じちたい}→自治体：13946_jichitai⟧ means local government or municipality in a broader sense and can include prefectures. {市町村|しちょうそん} specifically refers to the three types of basic local units.
